premises.text: Internet giants invest in global CDN-like speed and large security teams; ordinary websites lack those tools
premises.evidence_span: if you're trying to run a website today, you're left alone without access to any of these tools

premises.text: Cloudflare brings performance and security tools of big providers to any website via one DNS nameserver change—no hardware, software, or code changes (~5 minutes)
premises.evidence_span: all you do is make one change to your domain's name servers, and suddenly you're on the Cloudflare network

premises.text: Traffic through Cloudflare's global network speeds pages (~30% average) and stops spam/attacks while allowing any server stack
premises.evidence_span: We deliver an average of a 30% decrease in page load times
there's really only one price point for a service like ours, and that's free

premises.text: Network is a globally distributed caching proxy with deep packet inspection that can rewrite HTML in real time (e.g., fix Analytics, block XSS)
premises.evidence_span: built a globally distributed caching proxy that does deep packet inspection

value.text: Make the web faster and safer—sites fast, safe, and secure for anyone online
value.evidence_span: make the web a faster, safer place
